title: RunLine Hub
features:
Main Tab
• Grab Best Brainrot → Grabs the best brainrot from the selected rarity.
• Grab Brainrot Needed for Rebirth → Grabs the required brainrot for rebirth.
Plot Tab
• Auto Collect Money → Automatically collects money from your plot.
• Auto Equip Best → Automatically equips the best brainrots.
• Auto Upgrade Plot → Automatically upgrades the plot.
• Auto Upgrade Selected Brainrots → Automatically upgrades selected brainrots on the plot.
Rebirth Tab
• Auto Rebirth → Automatically rebirths.
• Auto Speed Upgrade for Rebirth → Automatically upgrades speed just enough for a rebirth.
Upgrade Tab
• Auto Upgrade Speed → Automatically upgrades speed.
• Auto Upgrade Carry → Automatically upgrades carry capacity.
Cheese Tab
• Auto Cheese → Automatically collects cheese.
Miscellaneous Tab
• Remove Lava → Removes all lava from the game.
Statistics Tab
• Player Stats → Displays player stats (Rebirths, Cash, Speed, Jump, Carry, etc.).
• Plot Stats → Displays plot stats ($ Multiplier, $/s).
Settings Tab
• Anti-AFK → Prevents being kicked due to inactivity.
• Toggle UI → Toggles the UI.
